segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you wouldn't really say an accidental pregnancy because it you know.
segments.zh: 所以你不会真的说意外怀孕，因为你知道。

segments.en: It's still a kid.
segments.zh: 它还是个孩子。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So you didn't want to get pregnant but you did.
segments.zh: 所以你不想怀孕，但你做到了。

segments.en: That's why we say unwanted pregnancy.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们说意外怀孕。

segments.en: Or you'll hear very often condoms help prevent unwanted pregnancy or the pill helps prevent unwanted pregnancy.
segments.zh: 或者您会经常听到避孕套有助于防止意外怀孕或避孕药有助于防止意外怀孕。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay so a lot of interesting stuff there.
segments.zh: 好吧，那里有很多有趣的东西。

segments.en: I think it's worthwhile for us to listen to our dialogue for one last time.
segments.zh: 我认为我们最后一次听我们的对话是值得的。

segments.en: All right settle down everyone.
segments.zh: 好吧，大家安顿下来。

segments.en: As part of this school's curriculum we'll be covering sex ed this week.
segments.zh: 作为这所学校课程的一部分，我们将在本周报道性教育。

segments.en: Oh boy yeah.
segments.zh: 哦，男孩是的。

segments.en: Now I want everyone to take this class seriously.
segments.zh: 现在我希望每个人都认真对待这门课。

segments.en: Sexual education is very important and I want you to ask as many questions as you can think of.
segments.zh: 性教育非常重要，我希望你问尽可能多的问题。

segments.en: Remember there are no stupid questions here.
segments.zh: 请记住，这里没有愚蠢的问题。

segments.en: Miss Carlton what exactly is sexual education?
segments.zh: 卡尔顿小姐 性教育到底是什么？

segments.en: Are you going to teach us like Kama Sutra and stuff like that?
segments.zh: 你会教我们《爱经》之类的内容吗？

segments.en: No Jason that's not actually what sex ed is.
segments.zh: 不，杰森，这实际上不是性教育。

segments.en: Basically we will talk about sexually transmitted diseases, contraceptives and how the male and female bodies work.
segments.zh: 基本上，我们将讨论性传播疾病、避孕药以及男性和女性身体的工作方式。

segments.en: My older sister is in college and she takes what she and her friends call the pill.
segments.zh: 我姐姐在上大学，她在服用一种她和朋友们称为“避孕药”的药。

segments.en: I never really understood what that is but I know it has to do with sex or something.
segments.zh: 我从来没有真正理解那是什么，但我知道这与性或其他事情有关。

segments.en: Good point Jason.
segments.zh: 好点杰森。

segments.en: This will be the topic of our first class contraceptives.
segments.zh: 这将是我们第一堂避孕药的主题。

segments.en: As you mentioned the pill is one of the many that exist.
segments.zh: 正如您所提到的，药丸是存在的众多药丸之一。

segments.en: The birth control pill is taken daily by a woman in order to prevent unwanted pregnancy but it does not protect her from contracting STDs from an infected person.
segments.zh: 女性每天服用避孕药，以防止意外怀孕，但不能保护她免受感染者的感染。

segments.en: Another popular method is using condoms.
segments.zh: 另一种流行的方法是使用避孕套。

segments.en: This is probably the best method if you have sex since it not only prevents a woman from getting pregnant but also protects you from STDs.
segments.zh: 如果您发生性关系，这可能是最好的方法，因为它不仅可以防止女性怀孕，还可以保护您免受性病的侵害。

segments.en: Yes Jason?
segments.zh: 是的，杰森？

segments.en: What are condoms made out of?
segments.zh: 避孕套是用什么做的？

segments.en: How is it exactly that a woman gets pregnant?
segments.zh: 女人究竟是如何怀孕的？

segments.en: Condoms are usually made out of an elastic material called latex.
segments.zh: 避孕套通常由一种称为乳胶的弹性材料制成。

segments.en: As for your other question, that's a whole new class.
segments.zh: 至于你的另一个问题，这是一个全新的课程。

segments.en: Alright so coming back, we obviously didn't cover all forms of contraception and forms of protecting yourself against STDs but I remember very clearly in school when we talked about this, they said the best protection, the best way to not get pregnant or to get STDs is celibacy.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以回来，我们显然没有涵盖所有形式的避孕和保护自己免受性病的形式，但我清楚地记得在学校，当我们谈论这个时，他们说最好的保护，不怀孕或获得性病的最佳方法是独身。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Celibacy is not having any sex.
segments.zh: 独身没有任何性行为。

segments.en: When I was in school they said the safest sex is no sex because there's always a little bit of danger.
segments.zh: 当我在学校时，他们说最安全的性行为是没有性，因为总是有一点危险。

segments.en: And so this is something that I think they tell a lot of young people to scare them but there is some truth to it.
segments.zh: 所以这是我认为他们告诉很多年轻人吓唬他们的事情，但这有一些道理。

segments.en: Yeah of course.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。

segments.en: Now what do you think about this topic?
segments.zh: 现在你对这个话题有什么看法？

segments.en: Do you think it's worthwhile and we should teach children sexual education or many people protest against it and say this is wrong, we shouldn't be giving kids condoms when they're in high school?
segments.zh: 你认为这是值得的，我们应该教孩子性教育还是很多人抗议并说这是错误的，我们不应该在孩子上高中时给他们避孕套吗？

segments.en: Well personally I think that kids in most parts of the world will have sex whether or not you tell them not to.
segments.zh: 好吧，我个人认为世界大部分地区的孩子无论你是否告诉他们都不会发生性关系。

segments.en: And so because of that, because everyone's going to, there are always going to be people trying it, I think it's important to inform students and inform kids who are in high school of options and of safety and of important health measures because otherwise you risk unwanted pregnancies and you risk people getting these very serious diseases like AIDS.
segments.zh: 所以正因为如此，因为每个人都去，总会有人在尝试，我认为通知学生并告知处于高中的孩子们了解安全和重要的健康措施是很重要的，因为否则你有意外怀孕的风险，你冒着人们患上这些非常严重的疾病的风险 艾滋病。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: I think it is a very important topic.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一个非常重要的话题。

segments.en: Some countries or some places even within the United States are a little bit more conservative than others and so many times they are against this type of education but I've actually encountered people who never received sexual education and well until they were maybe like 18 they thought they can get pregnant by a kiss.
segments.zh: 一些国家或一些地方甚至在美国也比其他地方更保守一些，很多时候他们反对这种教育，但我实际上遇到过一些从未接受过性教育的人，直到他们可能 18 岁才被他们认为可以通过一个吻怀孕。

segments.en: So I think that's one of the dangers.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是危险之一。

segments.en: Obviously there are both sides to this issue and we're curious to know what you think.
segments.zh: 显然，这个问题有双方，我们很想知道您的想法。

segments.en: Do you think that sex ed should be a course or should be something that people talk about in schools, in high school or in college?
segments.zh: 你认为性教育应该是一门课程，还是应该是人们在学校、高中或大学里谈论的东西？

segments.en: Do they do this in your home country?
segments.zh: 他们在你的祖国这样做吗？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
